newsitem.title: USA: Midwest Express to put name on new center.
newsitem.headline: Midwest Express to put name on new center.

text.p: Midwest Express Holdings Inc said Wednesday a new convention center scheduled to open in Milwaukee in 1998 will be called the Midwest Express Center.
The commuter airline said it will pay $9.25 million over 15 years as part of an agreement with the Wisconsin Center District, the agency that is coordinating construction of the $170 million project.
Midwest Express said the deal is believed to be the first corporate sponsorship of a non-sports-affiliated convention facility in the United States.
Midwest Express shares closed unchanged at 34-1/8.
